# Check it's acyclic using union-find
parent = list(range(16))
def find(x):
    while parent[x]!=x: parent[x]=parent[parent[x]]; x=parent[x]
    return x
cycle=False
for u,v in edges:
    ru,rv=find(u),find(v)
    if ru==rv: cycle=True
    else: parent[ru]=rv
print("Cycle:", cycle)  # False means forest => no triangles, bipartite
